acceptanceCriteria.requirement: Option, tree, and date rows are distinct from panel roots by stable component, part, and surface role.

Every rule traces geometry, typography, state color, disabled, motion, and surface/card/motif constraints to canonical authority sources without literal truth; implementation ownership is digest-only.
Canonical source changes produce an explicit source-digest drift failure.
Missing owner, source, role, or verification policy fails closed.
Mutation controls kill duplicate numeric truth, broad roles, and unowned exceptions.
Variants and exceptions have exact theme, density, and device scope; wildcard allowlists are rejected.
The complete 45-rule production inventory maps each confirmed issue from #293 through #310 to semantic roles, not filenames.
Validation is data-only and does not parse Sass/CSS, run visual tests, bind CI, or modify CSS.
The JSON Schema closes and types every root, ownership, reference, constraint, scope, variant, exception, verification, visual evidence, and issue mapping structure.

The validator executes the supplied JSON Schema and meta-validates owner/rule closure, required identities, typed canonical arrays, issue bounds, and required visual evidence against weak-schema substitution.

Malformed review policy or generated provenance fails; v1 issue mappings contain exactly one entry for every issue #293-#310 even when a schema-valid unique 46th rule is added, rejecting missing #310, duplicate #293, out-of-range, and mismatched mappings.

Missing component authority, every production direct authority replaced by component.el-button, same-module menu/metric sibling substitution, unrelated transition fallback, fake ownership, and selectors absent from their implementation file fail closed.
Dotted broad roles, literal or fake-source owned exceptions, and unresolved visual evidence fail closed.
A tests-only semantic ownership contract covers all 45 identities with real component authorities, part selectors, and role-specific canonical constraint references.
Production rules match the 45-rule semantic ownership contract, exact #293-#310 rule and role mappings, and a non-cloned constraint profile set.
